_comment: Which shaders the Look page offers. 'shaders': id -> file name in the shaderpacks folder (* = any text; the newest match is used; a shader that is not there is not offered). 'profiles': the first rule whose 'match' fits the Packed Packs profile's file name is used. Names and descriptions are in the language files (shader.<id>, shader.<id>.desc). Copy to config/vanilla-finest-helper/setup/look.json to change.
